node.title: Rate-half distance-three original-lift column-far converse
node.statement: Every official distance-three contracted split design has a two-parameter family of original rate-half syndrome lifts annihilated by (X-s)Q at all 4e+1 required slopes, and every lift is column-far. A common full locator would contract to a fixed support of at most r+1 points; 2r+1-column independence would then force all external r-point locators into it, contradicting their exact 6e+3-point union. Hence the official distance-three branch is equivalent without qualification to existence of the pair-Lagrange external split design.
